```{=html}
<style>
.ts-wrap { max-width: 10.2in; margin: 0 auto; }
.ts-note { font-size: 0.85rem; color: #6b6b6b; margin: 0 0 0.6rem; }
.ts-bar { display: flex; gap: 0.6rem; align-items: center; margin: 0 0 0.8rem; }
.ts-bar button { font: inherit; font-size: 0.85rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.8rem; border: 1px solid #55554f; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; cursor: pointer; }
.ts-bar button.ts-main { background: #b31b1b; border-color: #b31b1b; color: #fff; }
.ts-bar .ts-saved { font-size: 0.78rem; color: #6b6b6b; }
.ts-who { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; font-size: 0.9rem; margin: 0 0 0.4rem; }
.ts-who label { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.4rem; }
.ts-who input { font: inherit; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid #55554f; border-radius: 0; padding: 0 0.2rem; background: transparent; outline: none; }
.ts-who input.ts-name { width: 3in; }
.ts-who input.ts-teamid { width: 0.8in; }
.ts-sheet { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; table-layout: fixed; font-size: 0.82rem; }
.ts-sheet th, .ts-sheet td { border: 1px solid #9a9a94; padding: 0.35rem 0.45rem; vertical-align: top; text-align: left; }
.ts-sheet th { background: #f4f4f1; font-weight: 700; }
.ts-sheet th.ts-q, .ts-sheet td.ts-q { width: 22%; }
.ts-sheet td.ts-q b { color: #b31b1b; }
.ts-sheet td.ts-q .ts-hint { display: block; color: #6b6b6b; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.35; margin-top: 0.15rem; }
.ts-sheet td.ts-a { height: 0.98in; padding: 0; }
.ts-sheet td.ts-a textarea { display: block; width: 100%; height: 0.98in; box-sizing: border-box; border: 0; resize: none; padding: 0.3rem 0.4rem; margin: 0; font: inherit; font-size: 0.74rem; line-height: 1.3; background: transparent; outline: none; overflow: hidden; }
.ts-sheet td.ts-a textarea:focus { background: #fbf6f6; }
@media print {
  @page { size: letter landscape; margin: 0.45in; }
  .ts-note, .ts-bar { display: none; }
  header, #title-block-header, .quarto-title-block, nav, footer { display: none !important; }
}
</style>

<div class="ts-wrap">
<p class="ts-note">Meeting 12, session B. One sheet per student. Type your answers in the boxes, one column for each recorded talk. The sheet is for your own use and is not collected. Your answers stay in this browser until you clear them.</p>
<div class="ts-bar">
<button type="button" class="ts-main" id="ts-print">Keep a copy (PDF or print)</button>
<button type="button" id="ts-clear">Clear the sheet</button>
<span class="ts-saved" id="ts-saved"></span>
</div>
<div class="ts-who">
<label>Name <input type="text" class="ts-name" data-key="name" aria-label="Your name"></label>
<label>Team <input type="text" class="ts-teamid" data-key="team" aria-label="Your team letter"></label>
</div>
<table class="ts-sheet">
<thead>
<tr><th class="ts-q">Question</th><th>Talk 1</th><th>Talk 2</th><th>Talk 3</th><th>Talk 4</th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td class="ts-q"><b>1. Who is the talk for?</b><span class="ts-hint">What does the speaker assume they know?</span></td><td class="ts-a"></td><td class="ts-a"></td><td class="ts-a"></td><td class="ts-a"></td></tr>
<tr><td class="ts-q"><b>2. What is the message?</b><span class="ts-hint">One sentence, and the minute it arrives.</span></td><td class="ts-a"></td><td class="ts-a"></td><td class="ts-a"></td><td class="ts-a"></td></tr>
<tr><td class="ts-q"><b>3. How is the talk organized?</b><span class="ts-hint">The first minute, the signposts, the last minute.</span></td><td class="ts-a"></td><td class="ts-a"></td><td class="ts-a"></td><td class="ts-a"></td></tr>
<tr><td class="ts-q"><b>4. What do the slides add?</b><span class="ts-hint">What is on the screen that the speaker does not say?</span></td><td class="ts-a"></td><td class="ts-a"></td><td class="ts-a"></td><td class="ts-a"></td></tr>
<tr><td class="ts-q"><b>5. Which two delivery choices stand out?</b><span class="ts-hint">Pace, pause, voice, eyes, stance.</span></td><td class="ts-a"></td><td class="ts-a"></td><td class="ts-a"></td><td class="ts-a"></td></tr>
<tr><td class="ts-q"><b>6. What should your team use on December 2?</b><span class="ts-hint">One thing from each talk.</span></td><td class="ts-a"></td><td class="ts-a"></td><td class="ts-a"></td><td class="ts-a"></td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>

<script>
// The sheet is a plain page: nothing is sent anywhere. Each box is a text
// area, and what is typed is kept in this browser (localStorage) so a reload
// does not lose it. "Save as PDF" is the browser's print dialog.
(function () {
  var STORE = 'aem6991-m12-talk-sheet';
  var saved = {};
  try { saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE) || '{}'); } catch (e) { saved = {}; }
  var note = document.getElementById('ts-saved');
  function keep() {
    try { localStorage.setItem(STORE, JSON.stringify(saved)); note.textContent = 'Saved in this browser.'; }
    catch (e) { note.textContent = ''; }
  }
  var rows = document.querySelectorAll('.ts-sheet tbody tr');
  rows.forEach(function (tr, r) {
    tr.querySelectorAll('td.ts-a').forEach(function (td, c) {
      var ta = document.createElement('textarea');
      var key = 'q' + (r + 1) + 't' + (c + 1);
      ta.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Question ' + (r + 1) + ', talk ' + (c + 1));
      ta.value = saved[key] || '';
      ta.addEventListener('input', function () { saved[key] = ta.value; keep(); });
      td.appendChild(ta);
    });
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('.ts-who input').forEach(function (inp) {
    var key = inp.getAttribute('data-key');
    inp.value = saved[key] || '';
    inp.addEventListener('input', function () { saved[key] = inp.value; keep(); });
  });
  document.getElementById('ts-print').addEventListener('click', function () { window.print(); });
  document.getElementById('ts-clear').addEventListener('click', function () {
    if (!window.confirm('Clear everything typed on this sheet?')) return;
    saved = {};
    try { localStorage.removeItem(STORE); } catch (e) {}
    document.querySelectorAll('.ts-sheet textarea, .ts-who input').forEach(function (el) { el.value = ''; });
    note.textContent = '';
  });
})();
</script>
```
